title: Reproducibility Package v1.1.0 — A Causal Theory of Persistent Functional Self in Embodied Artificial Agents
description:
Complete reproducibility package for the study ‘A Causal Theory of Persistent Functional Self in Embodied Artificial Agents’. This release contains the executable Godot/Python code, scientific protocols, complete reference execution, independent recurrent-estimator comparison, 27-setting parameter-sensitivity experiment, analysis scripts, exact reference environment, provenance records, SHA-256 manifests, and manuscript sources used for the current results.

The study evaluates persistent functional identity in embodied artificial agents under adversarial morphology and appearance change. The complete rerun reproduces a strong within-CIAS effect of the persistent identity anchor. A separate generic recurrent estimator shows that the benchmark does not uniquely require an explicit Self variable, supporting a broader mechanism based on causal individuation, embodied closure, and persistent cross-time state. The parameter-sensitivity analysis identifies a substantial operating basin together with explicit failure regions.

The repository is directly executable with Godot 4.7 stable and Python; see README.md for one-command reproduction instructions. The preceding Zenodo DOI 10.5281/zenodo.22207678 is preserved as the earlier confirmatory snapshot.
